gates.rule: K is the smallest value passing gates 1-3; gate 4 must hold at every K. Gate 1: stop_aware RC <= 0.9 and Wilson upper < 0.95 on the hard cell. Gate 2: median(blind_exhaust expansions) - median(oracle expansions) >= 2 on the hard cell. Gate 3: easy-cell generation success >= 0.5 and blind_exhaust route-complete on every gated easy episode.
